description: Inhibit (disable) contacts in the specified range. When a contact is inhibited, it becomes inactive and does not compute forces, regardless of piece overlap or contact model logic. This provides temporary contact disabling without deletion. Inhibit has the highest priority among contact state flags - an inhibited contact remains inactive even if the activate flag is set. By default, only mechanical contacts are considered.

parameters.flag: True to inhibit (force inactive), False to uninhibit (allow normal activity)

methods.returns: True if contact is inhibited, False otherwise

notes: Python SDK requires iteration over contacts - cannot inhibit all contacts in one call
Command interface is more efficient for bulk inhibit operations
Use range specification in command interface to avoid Python iteration

command_vs_python.python: for c in it.contact.list():\n    if c.in_group('boundary'):\n        c.set_inhibit(True)

notes: Inhibit flag forces contact to be INACTIVE (no force computation)
Inhibit has HIGHEST PRIORITY - overrides activate flag
Inhibited contacts remain in system (not deleted)
Use uninhibit (inhibit off) to restore normal activity
More efficient than Python iteration for bulk inhibiting
Contact still exists and can be queried, just inactive
Useful for temporary contact disabling without deletion
Inhibit does not prevent contact deletion by detection system
Related commands: contact activate, contact persist, contact delete, contact model, contact fix
Inhibit has the highest priority: an inhibited contact stays inactive regardless of the activate flag. contact activate on clears the inhibit flag.

examples.description: Inhibit contacts in x-position range 1.1 to 1.9 (from official example). Use case: Disable contacts in specific spatial region.
Inhibit contacts with gap between 0 and 100 (from official example). Use case: Disable contacts based on gap criterion.
Inhibit all contacts in 'disabled' group. Use case: Temporarily disable specific contact subset.
Uninhibit all contacts, restore normal activity determination. Use case: Re-enable all previously inhibited contacts.

examples.command: contact inhibit on range contact type 'ball-facet'
examples.description: Inhibit all ball-wall contacts. Use case: Temporarily disable boundary forces.

examples.command: contact inhibit true range model linearpbond contact bonded
examples.description: Inhibit bonded contacts with linearpbond model. Use case: Temporarily disable bond forces without breaking bonds.
Uninhibit contacts in specific z-range. Use case: Re-enable contacts in region after temporary disabling.

notes: Live 7.0 grammar: the optional process selector precedes the subcommand ('contact mechanical <sub>' / 'contact thermal <sub>'); it is not a keyword of the subcommand itself.
